chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) concerning the power of Allah, and the virtue of the Quran, and the exhortation to piety.
ai.seo_question: What are the three main themes of Imam Ali's sermon in this section of Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading from Sharif al-Radi’s compilation frames a sermon where Imam Ali (AS) synthesizes divine omnipotence with the Quran as the tangible manifestation of that power, serving as the ultimate guide for taqwa. In Shia exegesis, this triad underscores the Quran not merely as text, but as the active instrument of God’s will, linking metaphysical authority with practical spiritual discipline. The emphasis on taqwa here reflects the Imam’s pedagogical approach, positioning God-consciousness as the necessary response to recognizing divine power and Quranic guidance.
